01Phase
1 Business Day Certified Engineers
DAY 1 • INITIAL DISCOVERY

Step 01: Consultation & Energy Audit

Our solar engineers analyze your past 12-month electricity bills, average daylight energy demand, peak wattage spikes, and budget to recommend the most cost-effective solar architecture (On-Grid, Off-Grid, or Hybrid).

Key Deliverables & Documentation

  • 12-Month Electricity Bill Analysis & Load Profile
  • Optimal Solar Capacity Calculation (kWp)
  • Projected Monthly & Annual Electricity Bill Savings
  • PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana Subsidy Breakdown (up to ₹78,000)
  • Financial ROI & Payback Timeline Estimation (3–4 Years)
✓ Free Technical Guidance✓ Transparent ROI Estimation✓ Zero Sales Pressure
Schedule This Step
02Phase
1–2 Business Days Certified Engineers
DAYS 2–3 • PRECISION AUDIT

Step 02: Site Inspection & 3D Shadow Modeling

A certified solar engineer visits your premises across AP & Telangana. We assess roof orientation, tilt angle, civil strength of RCC slab or metal shed, and run 365-day 3D solar shadow path simulations.

Key Deliverables & Documentation

  • Drone / Digital Rooftop Boundary Mapping
  • 3D Seasonal Shadow Analysis (Parapet, Water Tanks, Trees)
  • Roof Civil Load-Bearing Certification
  • DISCOM Transformer Feasibility & Sanction Audit
  • Optimal Panel Placement & Orientation Angle Plan
✓ 3D Shadow Simulation✓ AP Net-Metering Assessment✓ Structural Safety Audit
Schedule This Step
03Phase
1–2 Business Days Certified Engineers
DAYS 4–5 • ENGINEERING BLUEPRINTS

Step 03: Customized 3D CAD Design & SLD

Our design team creates customized 3D CAD layouts and Single-Line Diagrams (SLD). We select Tier-1 Mono-PERC / TOPCon bifacial panels, wind-load certified galvanised mounting structures, and electrical protection schematics.

Key Deliverables & Documentation

  • Custom 3D CAD Rooftop Blueprint & Panel String Layout
  • Single-Line Diagram (SLD) & Electrical Protection Schematic
  • Wind-Load Certified Galvanized Structure Design (170 km/h rating)
  • Tier-1 ALMM & BIS Certified Component Sizing
  • Itemized, Transparent BOM Contract with Fixed Price Guarantee
✓ Custom 3D CAD Plan✓ 170 km/h Wind Design✓ Tier-1 Module Spec
Schedule This Step

2–3 Business Days Certified Engineers
DAYS 5–7 • SUBSIDY & LOW-INTEREST LOANS

Step 04: PM Surya Ghar Subsidy & Paperless Loans

Dedicated subsidy team manages complete national portal filing for the ₹78,000 direct bank transfer (DBT) subsidy and paperless low-interest collateral-free bank financing options.

Key Deliverables & Documentation

  • PM Surya Ghar National Portal Token Registration
  • Direct ₹78,000 DBT Application Documentation
  • Paperless Low-Interest Loan Assistance (SBI / Canara / PNB)
  • DISCOM Technical Feasibility Approval Sanction
✓ Direct ₹78,000 DBT✓ Paperless Bank Loans✓ DISCOM Sanction
Schedule This Step
05Phase
2–3 Business Days Certified Engineers
DAYS 8–10 • TURNKEY EPC INSTALLATION

Step 05: Certified Turnkey EPC Installation

Our certified installation crew mounts the system with heavy-duty leak-free mechanical anchors, runs UV-resistant DC cabling in conduit pipes, sets up chemical earthing pits (< 2Ω) and lightning surge arrestors.

Key Deliverables & Documentation

  • Precision Rooftop Mounting without Roof Punctures/Leaks
  • Hot-Dip Galvanized Mounting Structures (80+ microns)
  • Dual Chemical Earthing Pits (< 2Ω) & Class-II SPD Surge Arrestors
  • UV-Resistant DC/AC Cabling in Rigid Conduits
  • String Inverter Commissioning & Initial Power Testing
✓ Leak-Free Mounting✓ Dual Chemical Earthing✓ Tier-1 Installation
Schedule This Step
06Phase
3–4 Business Days Certified Engineers
DAYS 11–14 • NET-METERING & GRID SYNC

Step 06: DISCOM Net-Meter Synchronization

End-to-end liaisoning with APCPDCL, APEPDCL, or TGSPDCL for bi-directional net-meter installation, CEIG electrical safety sanction, and synchronization with IoT mobile monitoring setup.

Key Deliverables & Documentation

  • Bi-Directional Net-Meter Installation & Utility Seal
  • AP/TS DISCOM Electrical Inspectorate (CEIG) Clearance
  • IoT Mobile App Setup for Real-Time Solar Generation Telemetry
  • Utility Billing Tariff Calibration to Solar Net-Metering
✓ Bi-Directional Net-Meter✓ DISCOM Liaisoning✓ IoT Generation App

  • 5-Year Free Scheduled On-Site Maintenance Audits
  • FLIR Thermal Infrared Camera Hotspot Inspections
  • Demineralized Water High-Efficiency Panel Washing
  • 48-Hour On-Site Resolution SLA Guarantee
  • Official 25-Year Linear Power Output Warranty Handover
